fixesDuringVerification: Fixed the nested discard dialog closing sequence; the full discard/reopen/save scenario passed on rerun.
Simplified question-sent content so its actions stay visible on short screens.
Allowed mobile protection summaries to wrap instead of inheriting table nowrap.
Widened Reader options so labels fit on one line; refreshed all affected PDF screenshots and reran search/navigation checks.
limitations: Chromium viewport simulation, not a physical phone or Safari/WebKit run. Software keyboard, browser chrome and orientation behavior on actual devices remain unverified.
Appearance previews are explicit-width sample canvases, not full browser/device emulators. Real link preview is the access-check surface.
No email provider, S3 migration, backup/restore, Docker install or release deployment was exercised in this UI task.
Screenshots were captured during the final verification pass. Affected states were refreshed after fixes; fixture counts reflect actual operations at capture time.
This is regression evidence for changed flows and adjacent UI, not an exhaustive accessibility or security certification.
